snapshot_note: All metrics are a point-in-time snapshot from the GitHub repository search API on 2026-09-15. Star and issue counts move; re-run tools/build_registry.py to refresh.
license_note: Licenses resolved against GitHub license metadata in two passes (2026-09-14, 2026-09-15). ruling=PASS may be forked. ruling=ESCALATE means either network copyleft (AGPL) or a non-standard license GitHub could not identify - a human must read it. ruling=FAIL means no license file exists, which in copyright terms is all-rights-reserved, not public domain.

candidates.use_case: Researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket and the web, then synthesises a grounded summary.
candidates.atk_relevance: Highest token burn per invocation in the pool: a multi-source research loop is many model calls. Routing plus a per-run token budget is a genuine feature, not a sticker.
candidates.risk: Depends on several third-party surfaces that change without notice; 129 open issues. Scraper breakage is the dominant maintenance cost.

candidates.use_case: Turns a technical book PDF into a usable Claude Code skill.
candidates.atk_relevance: Long-document ingestion is a large, batchable token workload where cost routing is the headline benefit and the savings are directly measurable.
candidates.risk: PDF extraction quality varies by source; output quality is model-sensitive, so provider switching must be validated per model tier.

candidates.use_case: Removes tells of AI-generated writing from text.
candidates.atk_relevance: Essentially one model call per invocation with a clean prompt seam - the cheapest possible place to demonstrate a correct ATK provider adapter end to end.
candidates.risk: Low. ~205 KB source, 13 open issues. Main risk is prompt-quality regression when swapping models, which is exactly what the provider-switch QA test catches.

candidates.use_case: Generates architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained HTML.
candidates.atk_relevance: Diagram generation is model-quality sensitive and visually demonstrable - the strongest social-content asset in the pool, and a natural multi-model comparison.
candidates.risk: 168 open issues; self-contained HTML output has a broad surface for rendering regressions.

candidates.use_case: Agentic video production: 12 pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ skill and knowledge files.
candidates.atk_relevance: Media generation is the highest-value token workload available and the best visual content source.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence. Very large surface (700+ files), heavy external tool dependencies (ffmpeg, image and TTS models).

candidates.use_case: Non-destructive context compression gateway for coding agents; drop-in for any BASE_URL agent.
candidates.atk_relevance: Directly amplifies ATK's cost narrative: compression plus routing compounds. Sits at exactly the layer ATK sells.
candidates.risk: Young project (created 2026-07), small contributor base, and its own 4B model is an extra dependency to host or call.

candidates.use_case: Turns a codebase into an interactive, queryable knowledge graph.
candidates.atk_relevance: Whole-repository analysis is a heavy, repeated token workload; tiered routing (cheap model for extraction, strong model for synthesis) is a real cost lever.
candidates.risk: 302 open issues and a fast-moving codebase; graph extraction correctness is hard to regression-test.

candidates.use_case: 165 validated scientific skills plus 100+ scientific databases for biology, chemistry, medicine and drug discovery.
candidates.atk_relevance: Enterprise/research buyers with sustained, high-value token consumption and low price sensitivity.
candidates.risk: Domain correctness matters far more than in general skills; a wrong model swap has real consequences. Only 10 open issues suggests strong maintenance.

candidates.use_case: Turns a codebase plus docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph.
candidates.atk_relevance: Heavy multi-document ingestion - strong routing and cost-tiering fit.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence. 1,342 open issues; non-standard default branch (v8).

candidates.use_case: Gives an agent read/search access to Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu via one CLI.
candidates.atk_relevance: High-volume retrieval feeding model calls; strong pairing with ATK routing for summarisation workloads.
candidates.risk: Scraping-based access to platforms that actively change; ToS exposure on several sources needs legal review before redistribution.

candidates.use_case: Local-first design surface turning a coding agent into a prototype/landing-page/slide/image/video engine.
candidates.atk_relevance: Already BYOK-oriented, so a provider seam exists. Media generation is token-heavy and highly visual for content.
candidates.risk: 1008 open issues and a desktop app surface - the highest maintenance cost among Priority A candidates.

candidates.use_case: Self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential setups with scheduling, failover, logs and usage.
candidates.atk_relevance: The natural routing anchor: ATK becomes one upstream channel among many, which is the Routing Principle expressed as architecture.
candidates.risk: Low. Only 20 open issues against 726 forks is the healthiest issue hygiene in the routing category.

candidates.use_case: Context-window optimisation with tool-output sandboxing, session memory and routing enforcement across 17 platforms.
candidates.atk_relevance: Explicitly a routing-enforcement layer - a direct architectural fit for ATK.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence. 245 open issues.

candidates.use_case: 38 editorial diagram types rendered as self-contained HTML + SVG.
candidates.atk_relevance: Visual output, small surface, easy provider seam. Excellent content asset; moderate token consumption.
candidates.risk: Low. Small codebase, 44 open issues.

candidates.use_case: Go AI gateway/control plane with a unified OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, routing, failover and cost tracking.
candidates.atk_relevance: Highest ATK Fit in the pool - it is the routing layer, so ATK integration is adding a provider rather than retrofitting a seam.
candidates.risk: Small community (1.1k stars, 100 forks) means little external validation; 72 open issues is high relative to size.

candidates.use_case: Hybrid deterministic-pipeline plus LLM code review with line-level comments and a multi-language ruleset.
candidates.atk_relevance: Already OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, so the provider seam exists. Per-PR review is recurring token consumption.
candidates.risk: Vendor-led project; direction set by Alibaba. Apache-2.0 NOTICE and trademark handling need care.

candidates.use_case: Design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across platforms.
candidates.atk_relevance: High-volume generation workload with visual output; good routing demo surface.
candidates.risk: 85 open issues at very large scale; design-quality regressions are subjective and hard to test.

candidates.use_case: Steers agent output away from generic, boring generations.
candidates.atk_relevance: Prompt-layer skill with a clean model seam; quality is strongly model-dependent, making multi-model comparison genuinely informative.
candidates.risk: Value is subjective and hard to benchmark, which makes the Beat-5 cost story weaker than for research skills.

candidates.use_case: 817 cybersecurity skills mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, ATLAS and D3FEND.
candidates.atk_relevance: Enterprise security buyers; sustained high-value consumption.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence: the repository description claims Apache-2.0 but prose is not verification. Security-domain content needs its own review.

candidates.use_case: Crash-proof file-based planning and session recovery for long-running agents.
candidates.atk_relevance: No direct model call site - it is a file/prompt protocol. ATK value is indirect (longer sessions consume more tokens).
candidates.risk: Low. 8 open issues. Main risk is that the ATK value-add is weak enough to read as a rebrand.

candidates.use_case: Generates presentation slides on the web using a coding agent's frontend skills.
candidates.atk_relevance: Visual, shareable output; moderate token consumption per deck.
candidates.risk: Low-moderate. Output quality varies by model.

candidates.use_case: High-performance Go AI gateway with adaptive load balancing and cluster mode.
candidates.atk_relevance: Strong architectural fit for ATK routing.
candidates.risk: 995 open issues and a non-standard default branch (dev) - the weakest maintenance profile among serious gateways.

candidates.use_case: AI gateway with guardrails routing to 1,600+ LLMs.
candidates.atk_relevance: ATK could be added as a provider plugin - but upstream contribution beats forking here.
candidates.risk: Vendor-led with a commercial product behind it; forking invites direct competitive response.

candidates.use_case: Marketing skills for agents: CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics and growth engineering.
candidates.atk_relevance: Directly useful to ATK's own content engine - dogfooding value on top of distribution value.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence.

candidates.use_case: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
candidates.atk_relevance: A skill collection rather than a runtime - no single call site for routing.
candidates.risk: Reputable maintainer; forking a well-run personal collection has reputational downside and little technical upside.

candidates.use_case: The public reference repository for Agent Skills.
candidates.atk_relevance: Reference material to conform to, not a fork target.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED: did not resolve to MIT or Apache-2.0 under the automated gate despite its scale. Manual review required. Trademark risk high.

candidates.use_case: Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph; 158 languages, single static binary.
candidates.atk_relevance: Token-reducing by design; useful to ATK users but not a routing surface.
candidates.risk: 582 open issues; C codebase raises the security-review bar.

candidates.use_case: Rust proxy and data plane for agentic apps with smart LLM routing and guardrails.
candidates.atk_relevance: Routing-native; ATK fits as an upstream target.
candidates.risk: Rust plus Envoy raises the maintenance bar; vendor-led.

candidates.use_case: The most widely adopted LLM gateway; 100+ APIs in OpenAI format.
candidates.atk_relevance: ATK should ship an upstream provider PR, not a fork. Being a first-class LiteLLM provider is worth more than an ATK fork nobody installs.
candidates.risk: 5,054 open issues and an enormous surface - forking is not maintainable at ATK's Phase 1 capacity.

candidates.use_case: Semantic retrieval and editing MCP toolkit - an IDE layer for agents.
candidates.atk_relevance: Reduces tokens by design; strong utility, weak commercial alignment.
candidates.risk: Language-server dependencies make the maintenance surface wide.

candidates.use_case: Agent skills for Obsidian CLI and open formats.
candidates.atk_relevance: Note-processing workloads; moderate consumption.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence. Reputable maintainer - prefer upstream contribution.

candidates.use_case: Unified API to route, manage and analyse LLM requests across providers.
candidates.atk_relevance: Routing-native; good architectural fit.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence - resolved as neither MIT, Apache-2.0 nor AGPL-3.0 under the automated gate.

candidates.use_case: Distils how a person works into reusable skills for any agent.
candidates.atk_relevance: Skill-generation is a moderate token workload with a usable seam.
candidates.risk: Moderate; non-default branch (dot-skill) complicates fork tracking.

candidates.use_case: Persistent cross-session context capture and compression for agents.
candidates.atk_relevance: Compression pipelines call models continuously.
candidates.risk: BLOCKED on licence.

candidates.use_case: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and others.
candidates.atk_relevance: Marketplace/aggregator - ATK is better placed as a listed entry than as a fork.
candidates.risk: Forking a marketplace competes with it; poor relationship economics.

candidates.use_case: Steers agents toward minimal, YAGNI-style code.
candidates.atk_relevance: Prompt-layer only; reduces token consumption by design, which works against the commercial dimension.
candidates.risk: Fastest-growing candidate but the thinnest ATK insertion point.

candidates.use_case: Self-hosted knowledge-graph memory platform for agents.
candidates.atk_relevance: Memory pipelines embed and summarise continuously - real token consumption.
candidates.risk: 494 open issues; mature project with its own commercial direction.

candidates.use_case: Personal LLM API aggregation gateway.
candidates.atk_relevance: Reasonable routing fit on the merits.
candidates.risk: ESCALATE: AGPL-3.0 network copyleft. Hosting a modified version as a service obliges ATK to publish complete corresponding source. Blocked for Phase 1.

candidates.use_case: Google Workspace CLI across Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs and Admin, with agent skills.
